gloss: to move out of the way; to push aside

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: どけていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to move something out of the way; to push aside; to clear away
definitions.explanation: To move an object or obstacle from a place so that the space is free. A common everyday transitive verb.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}をどけてください。
examples.english: Please move your luggage out of the way.

examples.japanese: {邪魔|じゃま}な{箱|はこ}をどけた。
examples.english: I moved the box that was in the way.

examples.japanese: テーブルの{上|うえ}の{物|もの}をどけて、{広|ひろ}い{作業|さぎょう}スペースを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I cleared the things off the table and made a wide workspace.

examples.japanese: {通路|つうろ}に{置|お}いてある{自転車|じてんしゃ}をどけてもらえませんか。
examples.english: Could you move the bicycle that's blocking the pathway?

notes:
A very common everyday verb for moving things out of the way. Written in hiragana in most contexts, though the kanji {退|ど}ける or {除|ど}ける exists. Typically used for clearing physical obstacles or clutter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荷物|にもつ}をどける: to move luggage out of the way
- {邪魔|じゃま}な{物|もの}をどける: to clear away obstructions
- {脇|わき}にどける: to move to the side
- {体|からだ}をどける: to move one's body out of the way

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. The intransitive counterpart is どく (to get out of the way, to step aside). Example: どいてください (Please move out of the way).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- どく: to get out of the way (intransitive counterpart)
- {片付|かたづ}ける: to tidy up, to put away (implies organizing, not just clearing)
- {退|ど}かす: to move aside (variant form, same meaning)
